correctness.rationale: For normalized uniform area on S², the side separation has density sin(d)/2; the two angle-at-endpoint conditions restrict longitude to |t|<d/2, while the third-angle inequality gives the latitude cutoff and excludes d>=π/2. Integrating in the fixed domain gives M0=1/(2π)-1/8 and M1=(π-2)/64; independent nested numerical integration gave 0.0341549430918961 and 0.017837385212327146, agreeing with those exact values. Common antipodal reversal cancels odd dipole terms; rotational isotropy of the rank-2 tensor gives three M1/3 cross terms, hence the full exact dipole law p0+ε²M1 on [-1,1]. Normalization and Taylor expansion of the von Mises–Fisher likelihood give the pinned derivative 2M1=(π-2)/32 and three-iid even quadratic coefficient M1. Strictly acute intrinsic spherical angles and measure-zero degeneracies are handled; local Fisher expansions are not asserted global.
